title: More than 1,000 volunteers built a four-bedroom house in 50 hours, launching 35-home community
summary_full: Over one thousand volunteers constructed a four-bedroom house in just fifty hours.  This remarkable effort provided a new home for single mother Yadira Salas and her children.  Volunteers worked in shifts, contributing their labor and skills to the rapid construction.  Salas also actively participated, investing her own "sweat equity" into the build.  This accelerated project exemplifies Habitat for Humanity's commitment to affordable homeownership.
